questions.q: How can customer reviews improve my local marketing?
questions.a: Reviews tell you what guests already love at each location, so you can build promotions around proven favorites instead of guesses from headquarters. When a dish, a team or a fast service keeps showing up in positive reviews, that's a strong candidate for a store-level campaign. You can even pull ad copy straight from what guests wrote.

questions.q: Why do national campaigns often underperform at individual locations?
questions.a: National and regional campaigns are usually built top-down, on assumptions, legacy best-sellers or seasonal pushes. Local tastes, operational strengths and guest behavior vary from store to store, so what's popular at headquarters can fall flat in a given neighborhood. Blanket promotions also burn ad spend and add work for frontline teams.

questions.q: How does AI analyze customer feedback across many locations?
questions.a: AI reads reviews, survey responses and social mentions at scale and spots patterns a person would miss in thousands of comments. It can tell you which menu item guests rave about in one city, which team members get mentioned by name, and which experiences drive top ratings. That helps you see which locations are best placed to double down on a strength.

questions.q: What is a feedback flywheel in restaurant marketing?
questions.a: A feedback flywheel is the loop you create when you promote what guests already love. More people try the item, more of them review it, AI picks up a stronger signal, and your next campaign performs better. The loop works for experiences too, such as wait times, friendly staff, music or cleanliness.

questions.q: How do I turn review insights into a regional campaign?
questions.a: Start by grouping review data by region and looking for items or experiences that keep appearing in your best reviews. Then build separate campaigns for each region around those favorites, using guests' own words in the copy. Momos can help here, since its AI surfaces the most loved aspects of every location from centralized feedback.
